description: List the addresses and domains this workspace never emails, newest first, a page at a time. `source` says why each is there: `unsubscribe` (the person used the link in an email), `reply` (they asked to stop in a reply), `complaint` (they marked an email as spam), `bounce` (their mail server said the address can't get email), `manual` (the workspace added it). `stream` says what it stops: `cold` (campaigns and messages) or `transactional` (your app's email). A bounce stops both. A spam report or a reply asking to stop stops `cold` when it answered a campaign or message, and both when it answered your app's email. `stream` can also filter the list to one stream. `twinSource` says why the same value is listed on the other stream, or is null when there is no other row. `q` matches part of the address or domain, case ignored.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

stream.description: Only rows that stop this stream: cold (campaigns and messages) or transactional (your app's email). Left out, both.

name: list_suppressions
title: List suppressions
